need: A layout repository's commit check and symbol refusals must judge and word things the way #977's edit hook does, so an agent that follows the hook can also commit.

searched.query: which other callers judge docstrings by the cog copy or name aes plan commands
searched.found: The whole-tree check calls docstring_mismatch and _missing_copy (cog only) and words its reason for .aes/target.yaml; symbol_gate words three refusals for `aes plan prepare/validate/accept`.

searched.where: cog (nedbatchelder.com/code/cog) documented behavior, from known behavior, not re-opened 2026-11-20
searched.query: can the cog regenerator add a block to a file that has none
searched.found: cog -r only re-runs blocks already marked in a file; it never inserts one, so the commit check's `cog -r -c` advice cannot cure a missing plan copy.

candidates.name: Move the layout rule into docstring_mismatch and pass a route string to the symbol refusals
candidates.covers: One judgment for hook and commit check; every refusal names a command that exists in a layout repository.
candidates.misses: Other `aes plan` wordings (plan-file edits, declared reasons) remain; they apply to `.aes/` plan files, which layout repositories do not have.
candidates.reason: Smallest change that lets the proof's agent commit.
